As owner of /v/YouAreFamousNow, I strive to make sure all posts are authentic. But, in doing so, it takes the better part of my time to verify the authenticity of the articles that are posted. I can usually trust The Smoking Gun because they supply police reports. But, I also try to find a local news source for the story. For example, if I find an article on, say, WaPo, I will try to cross reference the names and locations to try to find a local news site that ran the original story. Mostly, this is as simple as googling the name of the person with the town and state, but sometimes it's not that easy and so I hold off on posting it. Not until I have exhausted everything I can, then I will post from a major site.

But, I also think that crowd sourcing also plays a huge part in this. If someone were to come to me and tell me that one of the posts is fake, I would gladly remove it and add it to the section dedicated for logging all fake stories.
